(7) lang=id free tier still receives a translated summary (differs from EN) plus translated warning_zones — translation pipeline is not affected by the premium gate. (8) Regression clean: POST /api/asset/crypto/BTC/analyze still returns 200 (~17s AI ensemble), /api/push/history?language=en still returns the legacy dict shape, /api/dashboard?market=crypto&min_confidence=80&min_wr=65 override still honored end-to-end.
